purpose: Teach: 一式/公文書/リーク/プロファイル/新旧/未完成/偏向/覆す

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: プレゼン資料、本気で、絶対、一式、絶対、確認、絶対、いたしました
lines.en: I've verified the full set of presentation materials.
lines.style: Crisp, professional delivery. Slight emphasis on the completion—shoulders back, head level. Direct eye contact. Efficient pace, no hesitation. A small breath before the period.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新規取引の、本気で、絶対、公文書、絶対、整備、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're moving forward on organizing all the official documentation for the new partnership.
lines.style: Steady, engaged tone. Leans slightly forward with each update. Clear enunciation on key terms. Warm but businesslike. The pace of someone reporting progress they're proud of.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 情報の、本気で、絶対、リーク、絶対、防止策、絶対、検討しましょう
lines.en: Let's think through our information security measures.
lines.style: Measured, collaborative. A slight lift at the end—opening the floor, not commanding. Hands open slightly. Calm but attentive. The tone of someone inviting input, not laying down law.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社の、本気で、絶対、プロファイル、絶対、業界誌に、絶対、掲載、絶対、決まりました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Our company profile has been confirmed for publication in the industry magazine.
lines.style: Pleased undertone beneath professionalism. Clean delivery on the news. A small lift on 'confirmed'—the satisfaction of something locked in. Steady posture, genuine warmth underneath.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 当社の、本気で、絶対、新旧、絶対、社員、絶対、交流会、絶対、企画しましょうか
lines.en: Should we organize a mixer to bring our current and incoming staff together?
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly tentative—genuinely asking for input. A pause before the question mark, like she's testing the idea out loud. Warm curiosity, not uncertainty. Open, collaborative tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。マニュアル、本気で、絶対、未完成、絶対、章、絶対、まとめ、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're working through completing the remaining sections of the manual.
lines.style: Steady, methodical. Each task acknowledged without fanfare. Quiet competence in the pacing. A breath between 'manual' and the next phrase—showing the work continues. Reliable, unremarkable progress.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 業界紙の、本気で、絶対、偏向、絶対、注視しなければなりませんね
lines.en: We need to watch carefully for any bias in industry reporting.
lines.style: Alert but not alarmed. A slight tightening on 'bias'—the word carries weight. Slower pace here. Eyes focused. The caution of someone thinking two steps ahead. Professional vigilance.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、本気で、絶対、市場予想を、絶対、覆す、絶対、結果、絶対、出しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Our company is actually outperforming the market predictions—the results speak for themselves.
lines.style: Quiet pride in the delivery. A small emphasis on 'outperforming.' Relaxed posture, genuine satisfaction. Not boastful—just stating fact. The ease of someone who's watched good work pay off.
